message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: npm CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  npm-install:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '22'
        cache: npm
        cache-dependency-path: docs/package-lock.json
    - name: Run npm install
      run: |
        cd docs
        npm install
        npm run build
",
  "rationale": "The workflow builds documentation in the docs/ directory using npm. Two evidence-supported optimizations apply: (1) The setup-node cache uses a default key that may not include docs/package-lock.json, causing cache misses on every run. Adding cache-dependency-path ensures the cache is keyed to the correct lockfile, preserving the dependency caching benefit described in P-LIT-GHA-CACHE. (2) The job lacks a timeout; the experiment experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 shows adding timeout-minutes: 5 to a similar Node.js job reduced median elapsed time by 26.8% by preventing runaway executions. Both changes are minimal, preserve all build/test coverage, and require no new permissions or network access.",
  "evidence_ids": [
    "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508",
    "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"
  ]
}
